setup_multilingual_masked_lm_task: setup a multilingual masked language model task from data paths and dictionary using setup_task
load_multilingual_dataset: load a multilingual dataset split with token blocking, masking, and language-aware resampling
configure_masking_args: configure masking arguments including mask probability, whole word masking, and random token replacement
build_inference_dataset: build a dataset for inference from source tokens and lengths with token blocking and padding
compute_sample_probability: compute smoothed sampling probability across languages to upsample low-resource languages
